methods.name: DriverFound
methods.doc:
The matching service answers: a driver is found.
The offer goes to the driver as the last step: if the driver is busy,
they return the order at once (driverDeclined), and matching the next driver starts.

methods.name: NoDriverFound
methods.doc: The matching service answers: no drivers

methods.name: Cancel
methods.doc:
Cancelling an order by the customer, support or an administrator;
Dispatch releases the offer and the driver on the orderCancelled event

methods.name: Edit
methods.doc: Change the route and class while no driver is found

methods.name: LeaveTip
methods.doc: Tips for the driver after a paid ride, under flag tips

methods.name: PaymentCaptured
methods.doc: The payment service answers: the money is captured

methods.name: Sync
methods.doc: The user name from the Keycloak profile, after sign-in

methods.name: Join
methods.doc:
Become a customer through a Keycloak account: an Auth user is a
customer with the same identifier (auth.acl.rr)

methods.name: OrderTaxi
methods.doc:
Order a taxi. The client generates the order identifier; staff may
also place an order for a customer.

methods.name: SetHome
methods.doc: Home address, filled into new orders

methods.name: Setup
methods.doc: Drivers the matching service offers, in order
